translation_policy: Translate only the complete English fourteen-page edition in the multilingual original; preserve all native equations, variables, numerical data, source font programs, page geometry and original source anomalies. No editorial notes added to the PDF.

source_anomalies_kept.description: The grading-table version of equation (17) prints P2 V2 = nu2 R without the final T. That original native expression is retained.
The original sentence introducing L2 has a doubled comma after m2. Both commas are retained as native source glyphs.
The original centimetre unit following equation (32) uses Cyrillic см. Its native source glyphs are retained.

prose_whitespace_journal.scope: Only the actual spaces in the explicitly selected source grading-label sentence are classified as translated prose whitespace. Native equation spaces and all nonselected spaces remain locked.

bitmap_language_translation.method: White PDF background and Korean text overlays in explicitly reviewed language regions. No source image is replaced, resampled, or additionally painted.
bitmap_language_translation.font_metadata: Bitmap labels contain no font metadata. Times New Roman serif family, font size and baseline are inferred from the observed source ink and reference-family glyph metrics; matching Noto CJK serif is embedded.
bitmap_language_translation.terminology_note: Screen is normally translated 스크린. In the narrow two-stroke label compartment on page12 it is translated 막, the physical screen/barrier, at the same measured original size and baseline. This avoids clipping or shrinking Korean glyphs against the original diagram strokes.
